chapter: Funerals, dances and the end of the parades
title: Musicians he knew: Guy Kelly, Big Eye Louis, Perez and club dances
summary: White lists the musicians who knew him, praises Guy Kelly's trumpet, and describes social club dances and marching in.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
